business_problem: As the oldest commercial training center in the Middle East with a proud legacy of quality and safety, the academy was looking for ways to streamline its registration process, provide flexible and custom learning experiences, and make its numerous training opportunities more accessible to a wider set of prospective customers.
solution_summary: Saudia Academy built its Microsoft solution to improve employee-productivity and operational workflows. As the oldest commercial training center in the Middle East with a proud legacy of quality and safety, the academy was looking for ways to streamline its registration process, provide flexible and custom learning experiences, and make its numerous training opportunities more accessible to a wider set of prospective customers. Key components included Dynamics 365 Customer Service delivered dashboards, apps, or copilots to users, and Dynamics 365 Sales delivered dashboards, apps, or copilots to users. Requests and business records enter Dynamics 365 Customer Service, where Dynamics 365 Customer Service assists routing, summaries, or responses before the updated information is surfaced back to employees and customers through the Microsoft application layer. The stack stayed governed and extensible on Microsoft.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Customer Service
solution_components.role: Provides the case-management and service workspace for customer-support teams.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Sales
solution_components.role: Gives sales teams a unified CRM system for pipeline management and seller productivity.

solution_components.name: Power Apps
solution_components.role: Presents low-code business applications that connect frontline staff to operational data.

solution_components.name: Azure
solution_components.role: Provides the core cloud infrastructure and managed services underlying the deployment.

data_flow: Requests and business records enter Dynamics 365 Customer Service, where Dynamics 365 Customer Service assists routing, summaries, or responses before the updated information is surfaced back to employees and customers through the Microsoft application layer.
business_outcome: The platform resolved scheduling conflicts, improved PSAA's training efficiency by 100 percent, and increased training capacity by 400 percent, resulting in time and cost savings for both trainees and the academy.
metrics: The platform resolved scheduling conflicts, improved PSAA's training efficiency by 100 percent, and increased training capacity by 400 percent, resulting in time and cost savings for both trainees and the academy.
This cutting-edge solution not only resolved scheduling conflicts by 100 percent but exceeded expectations and increased course capacity by 10 percent.

The platform has improved PSAA's training efficiency by 100 percent and training capacity by 400 percent, resulting in time and cost savings for both trainees and the academy, and it has contributed to the academy's sustainable digital transformation.
The solution, deployed on Azure, logs 100 percent uptime SLA, while its AI-powered chatbots are providing learners with instant support and guidance.

TMS helped PSAA achieve the following KPIs and business outcomes: KPIs • 7,000+ courses completed • 100 percent migration to online payments • 100 percent migration to automated issuance of certificates • 100 percent growth in timely notifications to trainees and instructors • 5,000+ mobile app downloads and web access by users • 350 instructor schedules managed • 250 training facilities digitized Ongoing business outcomes Sustainable digital business : Achieving sustainability in the highly specialized aviation training business and accomplishing a significant milestone in digital transformational journey.
architecture_clues: Its existing Training Management System (TMS) front end, hosted on a non-Azure cloud platform, was experiencing an average of three to four outages per month.
Enhanced data security : Achieving data protection and privacy KPIs by assuring authorized personnel security roles are defined and adopted in TMS.

Transparency and compliance : Meeting the requirements of the General Authority of Civil Aviation for transparency and compliance by providing it with dashboards and access to TMS records for auditing purposes.
